audit.whatIsWrong: Sides are correct and both layers agree, but every full-layer phase why from level 2 onward is champion-wide boilerplate saying Karma owns the lane ('the lane is a toll booth and you own it') under rows marked Cassiopeia.
audit.why: The chart already reflects reality — Karma's only clean cast is level 1, and once Noxious Blast applies poison Twin Fang's refund chains out-DPS a single Inner Flame.
audit.corrected: Phase whys rewritten so each row states why Cassiopeia owns it; sides and the content chart left untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why is the generic 'no new ultimate at 6' line and never names Petrifying Gaze or its 120s rank-1 cooldown window.
audit.why: Mantra is available at level 1, so 6 is flat for Karma; Petrifying Gaze is the spike that ends her step-ups.
audit.corrected: Level 6 named, with the facing rule as the counterplay.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nowhere in the full layer does it say Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies FACING Cassiopeia; enemies with their back turned are merely slowed. The full layer instead spends its key-interaction slot on Miasma's grounding, which is irrelevant to a champion with no dash.
audit.why: Riot's own text: 'stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned'. Turning away converts a stun into a slow — the single highest-value fact in this matchup.
audit.corrected: Turn your back the instant she casts Petrifying Gaze and you eat the slow, not the stun. Miasma's real threat to Karma is the 24s-cooldown slow, not the grounding.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'add anti-heal early into his sustain' — wrong pronoun and no source named.
audit.why: The healing is Twin Fang (E), which heals for a percentage of damage dealt and is spammable at 0.75s.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal named against Twin Fang's healing.

edits.before: W tether threatens the root — anyone who steps to you early eats Q-W and donates the trade.
edits.after: Her Q poison lets Twin Fang refund and chain — one Inner Flame no longer trades back.

edits.before: Full kit: E shield-speed makes you untouchable in short trades. Mantra-Q (RQ) on cooldown gaps is a third of his HP.
edits.after: Poison ramps while Serpentine Grace drifts her in and out of your zone; the Inspire shield buys one exchange.

edits.before: Spam the RQ slow-field on his farming spots and keep your shield for Miasma — the lane is a toll booth and you own it.
edits.after: Your poke peak needs a still target — but she kites the Q line and chains Twin Fang faster than you can punish it.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Mantra was up at 1, so 6 is flat; Petrifying Gaze only stuns you if you are facing her — turn and run.

edits.before: First item amplifies the RQ chunk — keep him under 60% and the lane stays yours by default.
edits.after: Liandry's and Malignance make her ramping poison out-DPS your one AP item outright.

edits.before: Track Cassiopeia’s Miasma: Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her — turn your back as she casts and you take the slow, not the stun.

edits.before: Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 — you have no dash to lose, so it is the slow that kills you. Walk out early.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — 24s at rank 1, and with no dash to lose it is the slow that traps you. Walk out on the cast. - Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing her. - Your E shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Malignance or Blackfire Torch into Sorcs; then Cosmic Drive / Zhonya's by threat. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Malignance or Blackfire Torch into Sorcs; then Cosmic Drive / Zhonya's by threat. Anti-heal blunts Twin Fang's healing.

edits.before: Her Petrifying Gaze answers your Mantra all-in: step up to W-tether or drop RQ facing her and she face-stuns you mid-cast, then chained Twin Fangs delete your no-resist frame.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze answers your Mantra all-in, but it only stuns enemies facing her — turn your back as she casts and you take the slow instead, then walk out before Twin Fang chains.

edits.before: Catch your Mantra step-up with Petrifying Gaze (R) — if you're facing her you eat the full stun, then she deletes your no-resist enchanter body
edits.after: Catch your Mantra step-up with Petrifying Gaze (R) while you are still facing her — turned away it is only a slow, but face-on it is the full stun

notes: Both packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES: 'Petrifying Gaze' and 'Twin Fang' are her real R and E (the plural 'Twin Fangs' tripped the matcher). Highest-value addition here is the facing rule on Petrifying Gaze — it was absent from every path on both layers. Miasma's grounding is near-irrelevant to Karma (no dash in her kit), so I kept the emphasis on its slow, matching the mirror's correction of the fabricated 'E-dash'. Only 11 Emerald+ games, so the 36.36% figure is not load-bearing and no side flips were made on it.
